verdict.rationale: Docs and GitHub README both show explicit scp/sftp usage examples with configured keys/hosts (Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA), and Blink documents its Keys/Hosts config for password-less access used across ssh/mosh/scp/sftp. Community feedback corroborates solid connectivity and real-world usage, though none specifically test scp/sftp file transfer edge cases. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of scp/sftp specifically (vs. general ssh/mosh), and details on large-file transfer reliability.
